name: Masked Jester
desc: Laughs through every blow it deals you.
message: The joke landed harder than intended.

name: Twisted Stag
desc: Antlers grown into impossible angles.

name: Carnival Brute
desc: Dressed for a festival that ended badly.

name: Scaled Wanderer
desc: Weathered and vicious in equal parts.
message: Taken in one vicious, practiced snap.

name: Living Witchlight
desc: Burns with intent rather than fuel.

name: Searing Drake
desc: Too small to respect, but too hot to dismiss.
message: Reduced to a shadow on the ground.

name: Skulking Remnant
desc: Moves through shadows like it owns the dark.

name: Risen Shade
desc:
Should have stayed in the ground.
The corruption found it worth raising.
message: Fell to what wouldn't stay dead.

name: Lingering Echo
desc: Copies your movements with unsettling accuracy.

name: Poison Petal
desc:
Beautiful and unpleasant in equal measure.
The nectar burns long after contact.

name: Fever Shade
desc: Dead warmth fills the cold air around it.
message: The fever became your last dream.

name: Endless Swimmer
desc: Swims slow circles in the shallows, never tiring.

name: Crystal Beaker
desc:
Bubbles with a liquid that defies gravity.
Provides +1 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Iridescent Leotard
desc:
Moves as if floating on an unseen wind.
Provides +1 🟢 Energy and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Sharp Bamboo
desc:
Grows faster than you can bleed.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🧠 Intellect.

name: Mariner's Ear
desc:
Allows you to hear the heartbeat of the river.
Provides +1 🍀 Luck and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Safety Vest
desc:
Supposed to keep you afloat in the dark waters.
Provides +2 ❤️ Health.

name: Rusty Chassis
desc:
A twisted remnant of a consumerist era.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Moonless Watch
desc:
Darkness thick enough to press behind the eyes.
Bad dreams follow you out.
message: You slept. The nightmares did not.

name: Widow's Shroud
desc:
A grief too heavy to wear, but you wear it anyway.
Unique power TBD.

name: Widow's Heel
desc:
She walked in these once.
Unique power TBD.

name: Grave-Marker Pin
desc:
A cold, black spade that pins your thoughts to the earth.
Provides +3 🔵 Mana.

name: Exposed Ribcage
desc:
The bone is cold, but the protection it offers is absolute.
Provides +3 🔰 Defence for -2 💔 Health.

name: Infected Needle
desc:
One prick is all it takes to share the rot.
Provides +3 ⚔️ Attack for -1 🧠 Intellect.

name: Bionic Piston
desc:
Pumps with a rhythmic, mechanical hatred.
Provides +3 🟢 Energy for -1 💔 Health.

name: Buoyant Ring
desc:
Keeps you from sinking into the darker thoughts.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health and +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Scuba Mask
desc:
Glass is fogged with ancient, trapped air.
Provides +1 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Sunken Skis
desc:
Useless for snow, but they provide strange stability.
Provides +1 🟢 Energy and +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Reinforced Rod
desc:
Strong enough to pull secrets from the silt.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🍀 Luck.

name: Heavy Anchor
desc:
Solid iron that demands you stay exactly where you are.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🔰 Defence for -1 🟢 Energy.

name: Pale Ferryman
desc:
Poles the boat without asking where you're going.
Glad for the company.

name: Silent Swan
desc:
Keeps pace without effort.
Bad rivers don't make swans this pale.

name: Sunken Shrine
desc:
Still receiving prayers under the waterline.
Something about the depth preserved it.

name: Mourning Candles
desc:
Someone placed these for someone who won't return.
They haven't gone out yet.

name: Barricade Remnant
desc: Built to keep something out, and it worked.

name: Rusted Chain Gate
desc: Locked with a chain that outlasted its key.
message: Pulled until the rust gave first.

name: Thorned Archway
desc: The thorns arranged themselves deliberately.
message: Pushed through, bleeding less than expected.

name: Crystal Formation
desc: Grew overnight. Doesn't care that you need to pass.

name: Bone Barricade
desc: Someone stacked these here deliberately.

name: Crypt Slab
desc: Hasn't moved since the last thing was buried here.
message: Shifted it with everything you had.

name: Roughspun Coat
desc:
Cut for movement through bramble, not elegance.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🔵 Mana.
message: Smells of something tracked and abandoned.

name: Mudstained Wraps
desc:
Still standing is what they're made for.
Provides +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Void Silk Wraps
desc:
Woven from something that doesn't exist in sunlight.
Provides +2 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 ⚔️ Attack.
message: The fabric moved before you did.

name: Trampled Boots
desc:
Worn by something that didn't stop when it should have.
Provides +2 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 🧠 Intellect.

name: River Waders
desc:
Waterlogged past the point of remembering dry land.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Gaff Hook
desc:
Made to pull. Repurposed to tear.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Pale Grave Wraps
desc:
Woven from something that used to be warmer than this.
Provides +2 🔵 Mana and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 💔 Health.
message: The cold settled in for good.

name: Warlord's Remnant
desc:
Whoever wore these last did not walk away.
Provides +3 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -2 💔 Health.

name: Mourner's Plate
desc:
Heavier than it looks. Heavier than you wanted.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -2 💔 Health.

name: Forsaken Blade
desc:
Cuts through everything it touches, including you.
Provides +3 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 💔 Health.

name: Cracked Helm
desc:
Protects the skull, barely. The crack runs deeper than it looks.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Jagged Flint
desc:
Chips off more from your hand than from the enemy.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🟢 Energy.
message: Left a mark on both sides.

name: Lucky Foot
desc:
Luck taken from something that no longer needed it.
Provides +2 🍀 Luck, suffer -1 💔 Health.

name: Cultist Hood
desc:
Once ceremonial. Now desperate.
Provides +2 🧠 Intellect, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.
message: Read the runes on the inside.

name: Hollow Corselet
desc:
Still warm from its last wearer, whoever that was.
Provides +2 ❤️ Health and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 ⚔️ Attack.

name: Plague Leggings
desc:
Came off something that died wearing them.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.
message: They fit like they expected you.

name: Grave Mallet
desc:
Heavier than grief and half as useful in conversation.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🟢 Energy.
message: Swung it once. Didn't need to swing it twice.

name: Torn Scripture
desc:
Half the pages are missing. The remaining half are worse.
Provides +2 🧠 Intellect, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Peacock Mantle
desc:
Gorgeous and absolutely untrustworthy.
Provides +2 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 💔 Health.

name: Twisted Thorn
desc:
Pulled from a tree that didn't want to give it up.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🔵 Mana.
message: Drew first blood before you were ready.

name: Enchanted Eye
desc:
Sees things that haven't happened yet.
Provides +2 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Painted Vizard
desc:
Hides one face and reveals another.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🧠 Intellect, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: River Pearl
desc:
Found somewhere it had no right to be.
Provides +1 🍀 Luck and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 💔 Health.

name: Pale Wading Boots
desc:
Whatever they waded through left a mark.
Provides +2 🟢 Energy and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Mariner's Coat
desc:
Holds water in the worst possible way.
Provides +2 ❤️ Health and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 ⚔️ Attack.
message: Heavy with everything that soaked in.

name: River Trident
desc:
Three points of argument that require no words.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🧠 Intellect.
message: The river gave it up reluctantly.

name: Skull Signet
desc:
Counts something. You don't want to know what.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack and +2 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.
message: Felt eyes that have no sockets.

name: Martyr's Bandage
desc:
Someone wrapped this and kept fighting anyway.
Provides +3 🔰 Defence, suffer -2 💔 Health.
message: Protection at the only price left.

name: Warden's Vestment
desc:
Bound with thread made from something you won't name.
Provides +3 🔵 Mana and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -2 💔 Health.

name: Crescent Cleaver
desc:
Beautiful and immediately untrustworthy.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack and +2 🔵 Mana, suffer -2 💔 Health.
message: Cut something that wasn't meant to be cut.

name: Tide Wretch
desc:
Missing something vital and not adjusting.
Hunger brought it past the shallows.
message: Claws found the soft parts first.

name: River Crawler
desc:
Patient in a way that is never benign.
Sits still until it doesn't.

name: Wrecked Captain
desc:
The ship is gone. He's still giving orders.
Nobody left to follow them but you.

name: Sunken Grasper
desc:
Eight arms and it uses none of them graciously.
The ink went in your eyes first.

name: Scalded Revenant
desc:
The water around it shimmers with unnatural warmth.
Burns without flame.
message: Fever took hold and didn't let go.

name: Fever Leech
desc:
Clings to the hull. Clings to everything.
The heat spreads faster than the grip.

name: Pale Corsair
desc:
Sailed these waters long before they turned sad.
Still hasn't forgiven the tides.
message: Swords don't care who holds them.

name: Submerged Wail
desc:
The sound arrives before it does.
Something under the water is still grieving.

name: Pale Kelpie
desc:
Offered itself calmly, then changed its mind.
Reflects your hope back as something wrong.
message: Drowned before you saw the trick.

name: Mire Hulk
desc:
Too large to avoid. Too slow to respect.
You were wrong about the second part.

name: Sailor's Cap
desc:
Worn to the color of fog and river mud.
Provides +1 🟢 Energy and +1 🍀 Luck.
message: Sat it on like an old habit.

name: Kelp Hood
desc:
Alive enough to move with the current.
Provides +1 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: River Cuirass
desc:
Ripped from a boat that didn't make it.
Provides +2 ❤️ Health and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 ⚔️ Attack.

name: Waterlogged Surcoat
desc:
Heavy with everything it absorbed.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health and +1 🔰 Defence.
message: Heavier than it looked. Slower too.

name: Oarsman's Brace
desc:
Worn by the ones who rowed until they couldn't.
Provides +2 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Silt Walker's Wrap
desc:
Waterproofed by every river it's been dragged through.
Provides +1 ❤️ Health and +1 🔰 Defence, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.
message: The mud kept the rest out.

name: Harpoon Blade
desc:
Made for fish. Works on most things.
Provides +1 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: River Pickaxe
desc:
Pulled from the silt with someone else's grip still on it.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -2 🟢 Energy.
message: The swing connected. You barely held on.

name: Pale Tidal Ring
desc:
Found in the shallows where the drowned forget themselves.
Provides +1 🍀 Luck and +2 🔵 Mana.

name: Drifter's Compass
desc:
Points somewhere. Not necessarily where you want to go.
Provides +2 🧠 Intellect, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.
message: Found a direction. Not sure which one.

name: Capsized Memory
desc:
A jar, sealed, still moving against the current.
Something inside presses against the glass.

name: Low Tide Mark
desc:
The stone is stained where the water used to reach.
It hasn't been that high in years.

name: Fisherman's Last Catch
desc:
Strung on a line that goes nowhere now.
The fish are long gone but the line remains.

name: Forgotten Oarlock
desc:
The rest of the vessel is elsewhere.
This piece came ashore alone.

name: Pale Crossing
desc:
The stones are slick and tilted the wrong way.
Someone tried to mark the safe path.

name: Spiked Buoy
desc:
Bobs innocently. Retaliates with barbs.
Tempting to hit. Wrong move.

name: Floating Barrel
desc:
Sealed with something that doesn't want to stay sealed.
The impact made the decision for it.

name: Nest of Eels
desc:
The water ripples before you can see them.
Attack first and find out how many there are.
message: Found out how many there were.

name: Spinning Current
desc:
The water moves in ways rivers shouldn't.
Roll and you're part of the rotation.

name: Slick Crossing
desc:
A section of river locked solid at the wrong moment.
Roll and meet the ice at speed.

name: Ghost Net
desc:
Left behind by whoever fished here last.
Still catches things.
message: Found the mesh before the exit.

name: Sinkholes
desc:
The bank looked solid from the boat.
It never held anyone for long.

name: Submerged Ram
desc:
The hull found it before you did.
The river forgave neither apology nor injury.

name: Flood Surge
desc:
The water rises without warning.
Speed has nothing to do with surviving this.
message: The surge had the final word.

name: Drowned Memory
desc:
A face rises from the water that you recognize.
Better not to linger on it.

name: Hollow Warden
desc:
Has guarded something here since before the rot set in.
No longer sure what.
message: Guarded you right out of the living.

name: Grave Pilgrim
desc:
Came here with purpose and stayed past it.
Still hasn't turned back.
message: The pilgrimage finished what you started.

name: Bone Revenant
desc:
Doesn't know why it's still here. Hasn't asked.
The motion is all that's left.

name: Tainted Cleric
desc:
Once knew the words to keep things like this away.
Now leads the things it used to bind.

name: Ash Howler
desc:
Feeds on pyres lit for other things.
The ash remembers the shape of what it was.

name: Smoldering Revenant
desc:
The flame inside the skull hasn't gone out yet.
It lights nothing. It just burns.
message: Lit you up on the way out.

name: Barbed Lizard
desc:
The spines grew in after the rest of it died.
Waits for you to look elsewhere.
message: Spines found the gap without looking.

name: Plague Swarm
desc:
Moves like weather. Behaves nothing like it.
No mouth, no eyes. Spreads anyway.

name: Putrid Shambler
desc:
Moves slow enough that you underestimate it.
The smell arrives first.
message: The rot spread through the wound.

name: Shifting Wraith
desc:
Shows you what you were doing wrong.
Immediately before applying the correction.
message: Your own move came back worse.

name: Grave Silks
desc:
Stitched for someone's last occasion, never worn.
Provides +2 ❤️ Health and +1 🔵 Mana.

name: Burial Shroud
desc:
Wrapped around things that didn't stay dead.
Provides +2 🟢 Energy and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 💔 Health.
message: Wore a stranger's grief for a while.

name: Iron Vestments
desc:
Hammered from crypt gates by someone with nothing to lose.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🔰 Defence, suffer -2 💔 Health.

name: Burial Greaves
desc:
Dug up still on someone else.
Provides +2 🔰 Defence and +1 🟢 Energy, suffer -1 💔 Health.
message: Put them on and kept moving.

name: Hollow Wrappings
desc:
Unwound from someone who didn't need them anymore.
Provides +2 🟢 Energy and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -2 💔 Health.
message: The binding held where you didn't.

name: Crypt Treads
desc:
Worn flat on stone that doesn't forgive missteps.
Provides +2 🔰 Defence, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Condemned Coif
desc:
Inscribed with the last lesson learned here.
Provides +2 🧠 Intellect and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 💔 Health.
message: Read the inscription before wearing it.

name: Void Circlet
desc:
Opens something in the forehead that was better closed.
Provides +3 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Grave Reaver
desc:
Pulled from the stone with both hands because it required both.
Provides +3 ⚔️ Attack, suffer -2 💔 Health.
message: Took it from where it was buried.

name: Tainted Mace
desc:
Corrodes whatever it touches, including the hand holding it.
Provides +2 ⚔️ Attack and +1 🔵 Mana, suffer -1 🍀 Luck.

name: Hollow Bell
desc:
Hangs from a post with no rope to ring it.
The sound comes anyway.

name: Withered Wreath
desc:
Someone thought flowers would mean something here.
They still might.

name: Sunken Mosaic
desc:
Visible through the grime if you stop long enough to look.
It shows something that no longer exists.

name: Open Mausoleum
desc:
The door is open and nothing came out.
Something went in.

name: Scattered Petals
desc:
Too fresh to be old. Someone was here recently.
The petals are still soft.

name: Vigil Collapse
desc:
The grief of watching something that doesn't move finally lands.
The knees give before the will does.

name: Necrotic Mist
desc:
Rolls in from the crypts just before dawn.
Nobody who breathes it chooses to sleep — they just do.
message: Breathed the dark in and stopped.

name: Stone Cold
desc:
The silence presses in until the body gives up deciding.
Not peace. Just absence.
message: The cold made the choice for you.

name: Coffin Collapse
desc:
The lid gave without warning.
The weight of the dead lands hard.

name: Grave Sinkhole
desc:
The ground gives between one step and the next.
No time to correct.
message: Fell before you could decide not to.

name: Collapsed Arch
desc:
Fell some time ago. Hasn't moved since.
Blocking the way with the authority of stone.

name: Root Overgrowth
desc:
Grew through the stone while nothing was watching.
The roots don't care about your direction.
message: Pulled them back enough to pass.

name: Cursed Flagstone
desc:
Looks like every other stone in the floor.
It isn't.
message: The floor didn't hold what you expected.

name: Ancestral Portrait
desc:
The painted eyes follow. Strike it and find out what's inside.
The frame shattered. Something didn't.

name: Bone Debt
desc:
The dead here expect a price for passage.
Roll to resist, or pay in health.
